name: Boltz v2.2.1: Minor bug fixes
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: redundant PoseBustersPotential bounds by @simonlevine in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/478
* Fix help message in --use_potentials flag by @Alberto024 in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/487
* Minor simplification of Diffusion Loss by @shenoynikhil in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/486
* Fix: update filter_inputs_affinity to only filter records if override=False by @tobiasploetz in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/483
* Allow case-insensitive input suffixes and correct docstring mismatch by @Jnelen in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/481
* Minor guidance_update renaming cleanup by @JoshuaMeyers in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/489
* bugfix: NoneType not iterable when inference_pocket_constraints is None by @JoshuaMeyers in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/493
* Bug fix in bias repeat when multiplicity > 1 by @shenoynikhil in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/524
* Pad cyclic_period to ensure tensors passed to forward have a static size by @Adam27X in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/546
* Fix bf16 dropout by @tlitfin-unsw in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/554
* Minor tweaks to the documentation by @timholy in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/561
* Minor bugfix to potentials by @JoshuaMeyers in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/548

## New Contributors
* @Alberto024 made their first contribution in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/487
* @Jnelen made their first contribution in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/481
* @JoshuaMeyers made their first contribution in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/489
* @Adam27X made their first contribution in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/546
* @tlitfin-unsw made their first contribution in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/554
* @timholy made their first contribution in https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/pull/561

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jwohlwend/boltz/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1
